scripts.build:nicole: npm run sync:nicole && npm run build -w @wl-universe/nicole-levin-client
scripts.test:nicole: npm run sync:nicole && npm run test -w @wl-universe/nicole-levin-client -- --watchAll=false
scripts.docker:build:nicole: docker build -f deploy/docker/spa-static.Dockerfile --build-arg APP_DIR=packages/nicole-levin --build-arg APP_NAME=nicole-levin -t wl-universe/nicole-levin:local .
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:generate && npm run build -w @wl-universe/docs
